variants.name: close-without-finally
variants.why: calls f.close() at the end of the loop body, which an exception skips

logscan.py:
with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            total += sum(1 for line in f if "ERROR" in line)

f = open(path, encoding="utf-8")
        total += sum(1 for line in f if "ERROR" in line)
        f.close()
